name: Cantation of Manifestation
summary: In the Undercity, Anastasia Hartwell sends apprentices to reveal unseen beings in Algernon's shop.

sections.title: Unveiling the Invisible
sections.body: The Cantation of Manifestation brings beings hidden by magic into sight. Anastasia Hartwell keeps the scroll in the Magic Quarter and entrusts it to capable mages sent to contain rogue magical anomalies. In the Apothecarium, Algernon's alchemical workshop is troubled by arcane instability. Read aloud there, the cantation reveals stray rift spawns so the caster can subdue them and seal them in containment coffers for study.

faq.q: What does the Cantation of Manifestation do?
faq.answer: The Cantation of Manifestation reveals invisible arcane anomalies. Recite it where magical tears or disturbances trouble an area, and unseen creatures such as rift spawns come into sight for you to fight and capture.

faq.q: Where can I find the Cantation in Undercity?
faq.answer: The Cantation lies on the floor directly behind Anastasia Hartwell, the mage trainer in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia Hartwell need this scroll used?
faq.answer: A strange magical disturbance has broken out in Algernon's alchemical shop in the Apothecarium. Unseen beings made entirely of magic wander there, so Anastasia Hartwell needs you to read the scroll on site and reveal and capture them before the rift worsens.

faq.q: Do I get to keep the scroll after using it?
faq.answer: No. After revealing the rift spawns and capturing them in containment coffers, return the Cantation of Manifestation and the coffers to Anastasia Hartwell.

angles.text: As a mage, you use the Cantation of Manifestation in your early training to detect hidden arcane currents and contain volatile rift entities.
As an Undead, you know Forsaken spellcasters in the Magic Quarter watch arcane fluctuations closely, guarding the Undercity's stability against magical rifts.
